title: EarnProof Contract Event Fixture
description: Schema for versioned, network-agnostic contract event fixtures used by backend indexers.

event.description: Unique event name matching the Soroban #[contractevent] struct identifier.

contract.description: Contract crate name that emits this event.

contract_version.description: Semver version of the contract crate at fixture generation time.

schema_version.description: Monotonically increasing fixture schema version. Increment on any structural change.

topics.description: Indexed topic strings emitted in the Soroban event. First topic is the event discriminant.

payload.description: Non-indexed payload fields. Each key maps to a field descriptor.

type.description: Soroban SDK type name (Address, Bool, U32, U64, BytesN<32>, etc.).

example.description: Representative value for indexer integration testing.

emitted_by.description: Public contract function that emits this event.

compatibility.description: Change classification for versioning: stable (unchanged), additive (new optional fields), breaking (removed/renamed fields).
